why: Inserting the narrow check after C5 that forbids cuts between numerals/quantifiers and their immediately following unit/measurement phrases caused the model to stop splitting number+unit sequences (improving the smallest pieces, ≤3), but it also changed cut priorities elsewhere so many mid-length examples (bins ≤5 and ≤10) now get cuts shifted into noun phrases, enumerations, or auxiliary/subject boundaries; the result is a near-zero net change because roughly as many pairs improved as degraded.
lesson: A later revision should keep numeral+unit adjacency (so short pieces benefit) while avoiding wholesale re-prioritization of cut placement that splits enumerations or breaks cohesive noun phrases in the ≤5–≤10 bins.
